GRADE 7 KISWAHILI — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri completely.
   C. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri.

2. About Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri completely.
   C. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri.

3. About Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri completely.
   C. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 6.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri.

5. About Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri completely.
   C. Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri.

6. About Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri completely.
   C. Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri.

   A. Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri completely.
   C. Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri.

9. About Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?

   D. There is no need to practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela.

   C. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 7.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Ufahamu Ufahamu wa kusikiliza is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 7.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Ufahamu Ufahamu wa kusikiliza.
